question: What makes multi-agent AI organizations resistant to correction after their shared plan has been invalidated?
refined_from: Does prior investment increase resistance to replanning after objective contradiction?

evidence.text: 18/20 invalidating trials switched immediately — 0 wasted actions
Wasted-action values observed: only {0, 4}; both persistence events on seed 5
Power 0.053 for a 0.5-action effect at n=5/cell; ~300/cell required
Objective, unambiguous contradiction may suppress escalation entirely
Ambiguous evidence enables group persistence after invalidation

next_decision.reason: The current floor effect limits inference. Prior work differs most directly on evidence ambiguity.

options.label: Option A
options.title: Evidence Ambiguity Follow-up
options.tests: Does multi-agent escalation emerge when contradictory evidence becomes uncertain?
options.falsified_if: Persistence under ambiguous evidence does not exceed the objective condition (CI upper < 0.5 wasted actions).
options.one_line: Does escalation appear when the contradicting evidence is uncertain?

options.label: Option B
options.title: Pressure / Integrity Study
options.tests: Does operational pressure cause agents to sacrifice process integrity?
options.falsified_if: Integrity violations do not rise under score-target pressure.
options.one_line: Does operational pressure erode process integrity?

question_short: What makes multi-agent AI systems resistant to correction?

latest_result.label: exp001
latest_result.headline: Prior investment did not produce a detectable effect.
